title: The BigScience ROOTS Corpus: A 1.6TB Composite Multilingual Dataset
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on the creation and documentation of a large multilingual text corpus (ROOTS). Religious content was not a criterion for inclusion, exclusion, or analysis. One of the 498 source datasets included is 'OpenITI proc', which contains Islamicate texts, but this is not discussed or analyzed in the paper.
